blocks.prompt: 3 A man sold his stock of eggs for Rs. 2400. If he had 2 dozen more, he would have got the same money by selling the whole for Rs. 0.50 per dozen cheaper. How many dozen eggs did he sell?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi Sawal 2 jaisa word problem hai: ek darjan (dozen) ki qeemat \(=\) kul raqam \(\div\) darjanon ki tadaad.
Diya kya hai? Ande Rs. 2400 mein beche; agar 2 darjan zyada hote to har darjan Rs. 0.50 sasta bech kar bhi wohi Rs. 2400 milte.
Find kya karna hai? Kitne darjan ande beche.
Plan: darjan \(x\) maan kar dono qeematein, "Rs. 0.50 sasta" se equation, phir quadratic formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: kul raqam Rs. 2400; 2 darjan zyada hon to Rs. 0.50 fi darjan kam qeemat par wohi Rs. 2400.
Humein find karna hai: beche gaye darjanon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Dono soorton mein fi darjan qeemat likhenge; un ka farq \(0.50 = \frac{1}{2}\) hai. Decimal ko fraction likhne se hisaab saaf rehta hai. Fractions khatam karne par quadratic banegi.

Unknown chunein aur dono qeematein likhein
\[\text{Let dozens sold} = x\]
\[\text{price} = \dfrac{2400}{x}\]
\[\text{lower price} = \dfrac{2400}{x + 2}\]
Kyun: Doosri soorat mein wohi Rs. 2400, lekin \(x + 2\) darjan. Zyada maal usi raqam mein bike to har darjan sasta hoga.

Equation banayen
\[\dfrac{2400}{x} - \dfrac{2400}{x + 2} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: "Rs. 0.50 fi darjan sasta" ka matlab: pehli qeemat minus doosri qeemat \(= 0.50\). Bari qeemat pehle likhi taake farq positive aaye. Yeh bilkul Sawal 2 wala dhaancha hai: wahan bheren thin aur farq Rs. 100 tha, yahan darjan hain aur farq Rs. 0.50.
Dhyan dein: \(0.50\) ko \(\frac{1}{2}\) likhne se LCD mein 2 shamil ho jata hai; decimal ke saath multiply karte waqt ghaltiyan zyada hoti hain.

Fractions khatam karein
\[4800(x + 2) - 4800x = x(x + 2)\]
\[9600 = x^2 + 2x\]
\[x^2 + 2x - 9600 = 0\]
Kyun: LCD \(2x(x + 2)\) se har term multiply ki. \(2 \times 2400 = 4800\). Left par \(4800x\) cancel ho gaya aur \(4800 \times 2 = 9600\) bacha.

Quadratic formula lagayen
\[x = \dfrac{-2 \pm \sqrt{4 + 38400}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{-2 \pm 2\sqrt{9601}}{2}\]
\[= -1 \pm \sqrt{9601}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(a = 1, b = 2, c = -9600\). Aise do whole numbers nahi milte jin ka product \(-9600\) aur sum \(2\) ho, is liye factorization nahi chalti; formula hamesha kaam karta hai. \(b^2 - 4ac = 4 + 38400 = 38404 = 4 \times 9601\).

Positive root lein
\[x = -1 + \sqrt{9601} \approx -1 + 97.98\]
\[x \approx 96.98 \approx 97\]
Kyun: \(98^2 = 9604\), to \(\sqrt{9601}\) 98 se thora kam, taqreeban 97.98 hai. Doosra root \(-1 - \sqrt{9601}\) negative hai, aur darjan negative nahi ho sakte. Qareeb tareen poora darjan 97 hai.
Dhyan dein: jawab poora number nahi aaya; is ki wajah neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" mein hai, aap ka hisaab ghalat nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{2400}{97} \approx 24.74,\quad \dfrac{2400}{99} \approx 24.24\]
\[24.74 - 24.24 \approx 0.50 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 97 darjan par qeemat taqreeban Rs. 24.74 fi darjan thi; 2 darjan zyada, yani 99 darjan, par Rs. 24.24 fi darjan. Qeematon ka farq taqreeban Rs. 0.50 (theek 0.4998) aata hai. Is liye 97 sirf qareeb tareen darjan tak sahi hai. Imtihan mein aise sawal mein exact jawab \(-1 + \sqrt{9601}\) likh kar phir "taqreeban 97 darjan" likhna behtar hai, taake examiner ko aap ka poora hisaab nazar aaye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key "97 dozen eggs" likhti hai. Chhape hue numbers se equation \(x^2 + 2x - 9600 = 0\) banti hai, jis ka positive root \(x = -1 + \sqrt{9601} \approx 96.98\) hai, yani poora number nahi; 97 sirf round kiya hua jawab hai (97 darjan par farq Rs. 0.4998 aata hai, theek Rs. 0.50 nahi). Lagta hai sawal ke numbers mein chhapai ki ghalti hai: agar Rs. 2400 ki jagah Rs. 240 ho to equation \(x^2 + 2x - 960 = 0\) banti hai aur jawab theek 30 darjan aata hai.
